description: Foundation: scaffold the Vite + React 18 + TS (strict) project in the worktree; ship the authoritative Supabase migration (schema + RLS, including all 7 review-finding requirements); build the dependency-free pure lib core (theme-core math, contrast, sorting, derive, types); the CSS token layer (tokens.css base palettes + base.css); the esbuild pre-paint bootstrap Vite plugin; the Supabase client with config detection; and a token-consuming ConfigError screen + top-level ErrorBoundary. Also seed SETUP.md/README with the officer-bootstrap SQL and RLS/Realtime verification steps. This leaves a buildable, lint-clean, test-passing skeleton that all later FEATs layer on. Independent of other FEATs (it has no upstream deps); every later FEAT depends on it.
steps: Scaffold in-place in the worktree root c:\Users\paulc\Projects\ToDoS\.worktrees\classboard (which already contains README.md + .gitignore): create package.json pinning EXACT versions of react@18, react-dom@18, @supabase/supabase-js@2, and devDeps vite@5, @vitejs/plugin-react, typescript@5, vitest, @testing-library/react, @testing-library/jest-dom, jsdom, eslint + typescript-eslint + eslint-plugin-react-hooks, esbuild. Add scripts: dev, build (tsc -b && vite build), typecheck (tsc --noEmit), lint (eslint src), test (vitest run), test:watch (vitest). Create tsconfig.json (strict true) + tsconfig.node.json, index.html (loads DM Sans weights 400/500/700 via <link> with font-display:swap), src/main.tsx, src/App.tsx, and an .eslintrc / eslint.config.js. Do NOT overwrite the existing README.md content beyond appending.

Create supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql with the authoritative DDL from design.md VERBATIM-equivalent: enums user_role('officer','member') and task_status('pending','done'); tables profiles(id uuid pk ref auth.users on delete cascade, name text not null default '', email text not null, role user_role not null default 'member', theme_preferences jsonb not null default '{}', created_at), subjects(id,name,room,color nullable,created_at), schedule_slots(id, subject_id ref subjects on delete cascade, day smallint check between 1 and 5, start_time time, end_time time), tasks(id, subject_id ref subjects on delete cascade, title, notes default '', given_date date default current_date, deadline date nullable, created_by ref profiles on delete set null, status task_status default 'pending', created_at). SECURITY DEFINER functions is_officer() and current_role_of(uid) with set search_path = public, each language sql stable. handle_new_user() plpgsql security definer + trigger on_auth_user_created after insert on auth.users. enable row level security on all four tables. GRANT select on all four to anon, authenticated; grant insert,update,delete on subjects/schedule_slots/tasks to authenticated. alter publication supabase_realtime add the three data tables with the replica-identity contract comment.

In 0001_init.sql apply the finding-driven RLS requirements EXACTLY: (fix #1) current_role_of() body = independent `select role from public.profiles where id = uid` with a SQL comment stating the independent re-read under READ COMMITTED is the SOLE mechanism and STABLE is only a planner hint; profiles_update_self USING (id = auth.uid()) WITH CHECK (id = auth.uid() and role = public.current_role_of(auth.uid())). (fix #2) NO INSERT policy on profiles + a SQL comment: 'No INSERT policy by design — rows created only by SECURITY DEFINER handle_new_user (owner bypasses RLS). Do NOT add FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY without an INSERT policy or signup breaks.' Do NOT enable FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY. (fix #3) COLUMN-SCOPE officer writes on profiles: revoke the broad `grant update on public.profiles` and instead `grant update (role) on public.profiles to authenticated`; keep profiles_update_self (Policy A) as the only path writing name/theme_preferences; keep profiles_update_officer (Policy B, using(is_officer()) with check(is_officer())) for role changes only. profiles_read for select to anon,authenticated using(true). subjects/slots/tasks: *_read for select to anon,authenticated using(true); *_write for all to authenticated using(is_officer()) with check(is_officer()).

Create the dependency-free pure core src/lib/theme-core.ts (no React/Supabase/browser globals at module scope): DEFAULT_PREFS; the dark + light base-palette maps from design.md (dark bg #0E1726/surface #15223A/border #24344F/text #E8EDF5/muted #9AA8BF/accent #FFB547/danger #F0666B/danger-contrast #1A0A0B; light bg #F5F7FB/surface #FFFFFF/border #D5DCE8/text #141C2B/muted #5B6881/danger #C62F36/danger-contrast #FFFFFF; radius 12px; DM Sans stack); hexToRgb, relativeLuminance (0.03928/12.92/2.4/0.2126/0.7152/0.0722), lum, contrastRatio ((L1+0.05)/(L2+0.05)), pickReadable (black vs white, higher ratio), HSL helpers, adjustForAA(accent, surface, mode) (step 2% L, max 50 iters, darken in light / lighten in dark, first >=4.5 wins, else fall back to --text), and resolveTokens(prefs, resolvedMode) producing the full token map (--bg/--surface/--surface-2/--border/--text/--muted/--accent/--accent-contrast/--accent-text/--accent-weak/--focus-ring/--danger/--danger-contrast/--dot-ring/--radius/--font-sans).

Apply fix #5 in theme-core.ts: compute --accent-text ONCE by running adjustForAA against BOTH --bg and --surface and keeping the result that satisfies WCAG AA against both; if neither passes, fall back to --text. Single resolved token — drop any 'optional, pass --bg' branch. Set --focus-ring = --accent-text, --dot-ring = --text, --accent-weak = accent at ~22% alpha (rgba). Create src/lib/contrast.ts as thin re-exports of the contrast fns for test discoverability.

Create src/lib/types.ts (DB row types + domain types; given_date/deadline typed string | null, never Date; ThemePrefs {mode:'light'|'dark'|'system'; accent:string; bgTint?:string; surfaceTint?:string}), src/lib/sorting.ts (nearest-deadline-first, nulls last, stable tiebreak by given_date then id, operating on YYYY-MM-DD strings), and src/lib/derive.ts (subjectHasPending, isOverdue using string compare with a YYYY-MM-DD today, localTodayISO(d=new Date()) using local getFullYear/getMonth()+1/getDate with zero-pad and an explicit comment forbidding toISOString()).

Create src/styles/tokens.css (:root base-palette declarations selected by data-mode="light|dark" on <html>, matching the theme-core base maps) and src/styles/base.css (resets, DM Sans typography via --font-sans, :focus-visible ring rules using --focus-ring, 10–14px radius via --radius). Components will consume ONLY these tokens.

Create src/lib/supabase.ts: read import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_URL + VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY; export isConfigured = Boolean(url && anonKey && /^https?:\/\//.test(url)); when configured create the client once with auth {persistSession:true, autoRefreshToken:true, detectSessionInUrl:true}; when not, export supabase = null. Create src/components/ConfigError.tsx and src/components/ErrorBoundary.tsx that per fix #7 style via live CSS tokens (var(--bg)/var(--surface)/var(--text)) applied by the pre-paint bootstrap, NOT a hardcoded dark palette (dark is the automatic fallback only if the bootstrap failed). App.tsx renders <ConfigError/> when !isConfigured.

Create vite.config.ts with @vitejs/plugin-react AND the pre-paint bootstrap plugin: hook transformIndexHtml, run esbuild.build({ entryPoints:['src/lib/theme-core.ts'], bundle:true, format:'iife', globalName:'CBTheme', minify:true, write:false, platform:'browser', target:'es2018' }), inject the resulting IIFE string as an inline <script> in <head> BEFORE the app bundle, followed by a tiny inline stub that reads localStorage 'cb-theme' (defensive parse; missing/malformed -> CBTheme.DEFAULT_PREFS), resolves 'system' via matchMedia, sets document.documentElement.dataset.mode, calls CBTheme.resolveTokens(prefs, resolvedMode), writes each custom property on documentElement, wrapped in try/catch falling back to default dark. Do NOT use Function.prototype.toString().

Create SETUP.md and extend README.md: env setup (.env from .env.example with VITE_SUPABASE_URL/VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY); Google OAuth config; the officer-bootstrap SQL (promote the first user to officer by email); the alter publication / Realtime enablement + anon-Realtime verification step (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE reach an un-authenticated subscriber; one-line replica-identity check); the current_role_of coupling note (load-bearing for all self-updates incl. theme saves); the VITE_REALTIME_FALLBACK flag note (fix #4); and the RLS proof curls / manual steps placeholder (filled by FEAT-002). Create .env.example with placeholder keys (committed; .env stays gitignored).
Commit locally on branch classboard with git -C c:\Users\paulc\Projects\ToDoS\.worktrees\classboard (stage specific files, not git add .). Never push.
acceptance_criteria: `npm install` then `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit) reports no type errors in the worktree.
`npm run build` succeeds and dist/index.html contains the inline theme bootstrap <script> in <head> before the app bundle script.
`npm run test` runs (even if FEAT-001 ships only smoke tests) and passes; the pure lib modules import without pulling React/Supabase/browser globals.

supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql contains: both enums; all four tables with the exact columns/FKs/checks; is_officer(), current_role_of(uid) (independent re-read + SOLE-mechanism comment), handle_new_user() + trigger; RLS enabled on all four; profiles has NO INSERT policy with the documented comment and NO FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; `grant update (role) on public.profiles to authenticated` with the broad profiles update grant revoked/absent; profiles_update_self freezing role via current_role_of; profiles_update_officer for role only; anon+authenticated SELECT via GRANT + using(true) policies on all four; officer-only ALL writes on subjects/slots/tasks; the three data tables added to supabase_realtime with the replica-identity comment.
ConfigError and ErrorBoundary reference var(--bg)/var(--surface)/var(--text) (no hardcoded hex palette) per fix #7.
theme-core.ts has no import of React, @supabase/supabase-js, or use of window/document/localStorage at module scope (so esbuild bundles it standalone).
verification: cd into the worktree and run: npm install
npm run typecheck  -> exits 0, no errors
npm run test  -> all present tests pass
npm run build  -> succeeds; manually confirm dist/index.html has the inline bootstrap <script> before the module/app script
Grep is NOT verification; confirm the migration by reading 0001_init.sql end-to-end against the acceptance criteria checklist above
findings:
FOUNDATION SHIPPED. Verified in worktree: npm install OK; npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit) clean; npm run lint clean; npm run test = 37 passed across 5 files; npm run build OK and dist/index.html has the inline CBTheme IIFE + bootstrap stub in <head> BEFORE the app module script.

EXACT DEP VERSIONS (pinned, no ranges): react 18.3.1, react-dom 18.3.1, @supabase/supabase-js 2.45.4. devDeps: vite 5.4.3, @vitejs/plugin-react 4.3.1, typescript 5.5.4, vitest 2.0.5, @testing-library/react 16.0.1, @testing-library/jest-dom 6.4.8, jsdom 25.0.0, esbuild 0.23.1, eslint 8.57.0, @eslint/js 8.57.0, typescript-eslint 7.18.0, eslint-plugin-react-hooks 4.6.2, eslint-plugin-react-refresh 0.4.11, globals 15.9.0, @types/react 18.3.5, @types/react-dom 18.3.0. Node 24 on Windows/PowerShell (no '&&' chaining in this PS; use ';' or separate calls).

TOOLCHAIN DECISIONS: ESLint uses FLAT config (eslint.config.js) via typescript-eslint 7 + @eslint/js + globals (NOT .eslintrc). tsconfig is project-references: tsconfig.json -> tsconfig.app.json (src, strict, noEmit, jsx react-jsx) + tsconfig.node.json (vite.config.ts). Removed TS5.6-only 'noUncheckedSideEffectImports' (TS pinned 5.5.4). vite.config.ts imports defineConfig from 'vitest/config' (NOT 'vite') so the `test` block typechecks under `tsc -b`. Vitest config lives inside vite.config.ts (environment jsdom, globals true, setupFiles ./src/test/setup.ts which imports '@testing-library/jest-dom/vitest'). env typings in /vite-env.d.ts.

BOOTSTRAP MECHANISM: vite.config.ts has themeBootstrapPlugin() hooking transformIndexHtml; it runs esbuild.build({entryPoints:['src/lib/theme-core.ts'],bundle:true,format:'iife',globalName:'CBTheme',minify:true,write:false,platform:'browser',target:'es2018'}) and injects the IIFE + a hand-written BOOTSTRAP_STUB string via injectTo:'head-prepend' (so it lands BEFORE Vite's app <script>). The stub reads localStorage key 'cb-theme', parses defensively (-> CBTheme.normalizePrefs / DEFAULT_PREFS), resolves 'system' via matchMedia, sets html data-mode, calls CBTheme.resolveTokens and setProperty's each token, try/catch -> data-mode='dark' fallback. NO Function.prototype.toString used.

PARITY TEST GOTCHA: src/lib/bootstrap-parity.test.ts MUST run under the NODE vitest environment (first line '// @vitest-environment node'); under jsdom esbuild throws 'Invariant violation: new TextEncoder().encode("") instanceof Uint8Array' because of jsdom cross-realm typed arrays. The test evals the real esbuild IIFE in a vm context and asserts byte-identical token maps vs runtime resolveTokens. Later FEATs adding esbuild-in-test should use the node env likewise.

PURE CORE API (src/lib/theme-core.ts, dependency-free — no React/Supabase/browser globals at module scope): types ThemeMode('light'|'dark'|'system'), ResolvedMode, ThemePrefs{mode,accent,bgTint?,surfaceTint?}; consts DEFAULT_ACCENT='#FFB547', DEFAULT_PREFS; BasePalette + DARK_BASE/LIGHT_BASE/basePalette(mode); color math hexToRgb, rgbToHex, relativeLuminance, lum, contrastRatio, pickReadable('#000000'|'#FFFFFF'), AA_NORMAL=4.5; HSL rgbToHsl/hslToRgb; withAlpha(hex,a)->rgba string; adjustForAA(accent,surface,mode)-> hex|null (2%L step, 50 iters, darken light/lighten dark, null when unreachable); resolveAccentText(accent,bg,surface,text,mode) picks the candidate clearing AA vs BOTH bg+surface else returns text (fix #5 — single resolved token, no 'optional pass --bg' branch); resolveTokens(prefs,resolvedMode)->TokenMap with keys --bg --surface --surface-2 --border --text --muted --accent --accent-contrast --accent-text --accent-weak --focus-ring --danger --danger-contrast --dot-ring --radius --font-sans; resolveMode(mode,prefersDark); normalizePrefs(unknown)->ThemePrefs (defensive). --focus-ring=--accent-text, --dot-ring=--text, --accent-weak=accent@22% alpha, --surface-2 = surface lightened(dark)/darkened(light) by 0.05 L, --radius='12px'. src/lib/contrast.ts re-exports the contrast fns.

TYPES (src/lib/types.ts): ROW types (snake_case, as Supabase returns) ProfileRow/SubjectRow/ScheduleSlotRow/TaskRow; DOMAIN types (camelCase) Profile/Subject/ScheduleSlot/Task. DATE CONTRACT: given_date/deadline are string|null, NEVER Date. Later FEATs' hooks must map row->domain (subject_id->subjectId, given_date->givenDate, deadline, created_by->createdBy). ProfileRow.theme_preferences is unknown -> normalizePrefs into Profile.themePreferences.

DERIVE/SORT (pure): src/lib/derive.ts subjectHasPending(subjectId,tasks), isOverdue(task,today) (string compare), localTodayISO(d=new Date()) (local getters, +1 month, zero-pad, NEVER toISOString). src/lib/sorting.ts sortByDeadline(tasks) returns a NEW array, nearest-first, undated last, tiebreak givenDate then id.

SUPABASE CLIENT (src/lib/supabase.ts): exports isConfigured (bool), supabase (SupabaseClient|null), missingConfig (string[] of missing/invalid env names, used by ConfigError), realtimeFallback (bool from VITE_REALTIME_FALLBACK==='1'). Client created once with auth{persistSession,autoRefreshToken,detectSessionInUrl:true}. App.tsx renders <ConfigError/> when !isConfigured. ConfigError.tsx + ErrorBoundary.tsx style via live tokens var(--bg)/--surface/--text (fix #7), NOT hardcoded hex. main.tsx wraps <App/> in <ErrorBoundary> and imports styles/tokens.css + styles/base.css.

CSS: src/styles/tokens.css declares base palettes under :root/html[data-mode='dark'] and html[data-mode='light'] (static fallback matching theme-core maps; runtime bootstrap overwrites inline). src/styles/base.css has resets, DM Sans via --font-sans, :focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset:2px } and .card/.muted helpers. Components consume ONLY tokens.

MIGRATION (supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql) — authoritative, ships ALL 7 findings: enums user_role/task_status; 4 tables with exact cols/FKs/checks (day between 1 and 5; tasks.given_date default current_date; deadline nullable; created_by on delete set null); is_officer() + current_role_of(uid) (independent re-read + SOLE-mechanism/STABLE-is-only-a-planner-hint comment) + handle_new_user() + on_auth_user_created trigger, all SECURITY DEFINER set search_path=public; RLS enabled on all 4; grant select to anon,authenticated on all 4; grant insert,update,delete to authenticated on subjects/slots/tasks; NO broad profiles update grant — only grant update(role) + grant update(name,theme_preferences) to authenticated (fix #3 column scope); profiles: NO INSERT policy + documented comment + NO FORCE RLS (fix #2); profiles_read using(true); profiles_update_self using(id=auth.uid()) with check(id=auth.uid() and role=current_role_of(auth.uid())); profiles_update_officer using/with check is_officer(); *_read using(true) + *_write FOR ALL using/with check is_officer() on the 3 data tables; alter publication supabase_realtime add the 3 data tables with the replica-identity contract comment. NOT seeded.

DOCS: SETUP.md (env, Google OAuth, officer-bootstrap SQL by email, Realtime enablement + anon INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE verification + one-line relreplident check, current_role_of coupling note, VITE_REALTIME_FALLBACK note, RLS-proof section placeholder for FEAT-002). README.md appended (getting started, scripts, architecture notes). .env.example committed with placeholders (VITE_SUPABASE_URL/VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY/optional VITE_REALTIME_FALLBACK); .env stays gitignored.

FOR LATER FEATS: component tree target (SessionProvider>ThemeProvider>Layout>Header/ScheduleGrid+DetailsPanel/TaskList) not yet built — App.tsx is a placeholder shell when configured.
